description: This file defines the Accounting class which extends the Currency class to format monetary values in accounting style, including setting currency code, locale, decimals, and formatting output with options for currency symbol position and spacing.

classes.name: Accounting
classes.description: A class for formatting currency values in accounting style with configurable options such as currency code, locale, decimals, and symbol positioning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize accounting format settings such as currency code, decimals, locale, and spacing options.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Generates the locale-specific currency formatting string, supporting ICU and PHP version checks.

methods.name: icuVersion
methods.description: Returns the ICU version as a float, parsed from a constant.

methods.name: formatCurrencyCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code formatted based on locale; appends '*' if locale is null.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the formatted accounting style string based on current object properties.
